description_ru: Современные отложения. Аллювиальные отложения пойменных террас р. Оби и ее притоков. Желто-серые, серые суглинки, супеси, пески, гравий и галечники
note: GGK-200 N-44-XVII (Geologicheskaya karta SSSR, 1st edition, approved 1965, printed 1970; Ob valley, Novosibirsk reservoir, 82-83E 54d-54d40mN), Quaternary map; RASTER = geokniga 2000x2312 px PREVIEW (~35 m/px); vertical lithology ruling removed (work/r200d/prep_vlines.py); tints calibrated on the map (preview_tint_calib.py), alQIII1 pinned to its legend tint; reservoir/Ob = WATER; alQIV, saQIII and alQIII2 print within 4-7 dE (56-77 % ambiguous): merged as one class E (hclass2 F); saQIIkrd (Krasnodubrovsk subaerial loess-like loams) and eolQIII-IV coded E (PI decision 2026-10-04; N-44_g3 codes the suite Y/L); alQII4, lalQIIkrd and the Kochkovo units appear only on sections; frame = 4 corners (TL/TR checked at 14x) + interior 15x10 min graticule crossings as ties ; same printed colour as saQIII/alQIII2: one class
